title: Reading Drill — Sheds for Street Tools
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Sheds for Street Tools
passages.body:
**A** A street maintenance team wanted fewer trips to its depot. It put cleaning tools in small locked sheds and gave each crew leader a key card. The sheds were placed close to work sites, with permission from property owners.

**B** At first the sheds saved time only on streets with level access. Staff could not roll heavy bins down the side lanes where the other sheds had been placed. The team moved two of the sheds uphill.

**C** At the end of the trial, the team continued using an ordinary vehicle for some jobs. The smaller sheds were most useful for routine checks, which required a predictable set of tools and could be shared with other crews.
